title: PostgreSQL
description: Connections, transactions, cache hits, sizes, locks and replication, with a user of the role pg_monitor.

address.title: Address
address.description: host:port of the server (loopback unless module_targets of agent.toml allows more).

role.title: Role
role.description: A login role (user) with the role pg_monitor and nothing more.

secret.title: Password
secret.description: Not needed with peer authentication over the socket.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: off (loopback, socket), verify (the certificate against the system's CAs), no_verify (any certificate).
